name: 海堡 · 废弃炮塔
blurb: 海面在身后合拢。废弃炮塔、芦苇、混凝土射击孔和临时生活痕迹挤在这座小岛上；枪声的答案就在这里。

points.label: 混凝土射击孔旁的狙击巢
points.show_when: (Variable["TASK.determine_where_shot_came_from"] == true and Variable["TASK.determine_where_shot_came_from_done"] == false) or (Variable["TASK.check_seafort"] == true and Variable["TASK.check_seafort_done"] == false)

points.label: 灰烬边持枪的老人
points.show_when: (Variable["TASK.determine_where_shot_came_from_done"] == true or Variable["seafort.nest_mainhub_got"] == true or Variable["seafort.deserter_prehub_reached"] == true or Variable["TASK.deserter_again"] == true) and Variable["TASK.open_blast_door_done"] == false

points.label: 穿过打开的防爆门，接近灰烬边持枪的老人
外面仍在漏油的旧油桶
points.show_when: Variable["TASK.fuel_the_generator"] == true and Variable["TASK.fuel_the_generator_done"] == false and CheckItem("fuel_canister_lum") == false

points.label: 芦苇里的巨大动静
points.show_when: (Variable["TASK.first_phasmid"] == true and Variable["TASK.first_phasmid_done"] == false) or (Variable["TASK.more_phasmid"] == true and Variable["TASK.more_phasmid_done"] == false)

points.label: 芦苇里留下的白色痕迹
岛上不寻常的寂静（远处的鸟翼声）
